work.author: GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS
work.description: Bull LXXXVI (GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS servus servorum Dei LF14952–14953) removes Panama from the metropolitan jurisdiction of Lima and makes it suffragan of Santa Fe de Bogotá; LF15010 → LF15019 across own provenance LF15013 and page-103 running title LF15016; LF15082 → LF15088 across page number LF15085; complete closing dated decimo kalendas maias 1836. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS at LF14952–14952; the source closing at LF15161–15164 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum anno incarnationis Dominicae millesimo octingente- simo trigesimo sexto, decimo kalendas maias pontificatus Nostri anno sexto, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
